instruction: Buy everything on my amazon wishlist, and have it delivered to my work address.
notes: Single-app task (amazon) plus supervisor. The wish list is modeled with 3 placeholder product objects, each with its own wish-list quantity object; at runtime the move action is repeated once per actual wish-list entry (ids and quantities read from amazon.show_wish_list), passing the entry's quantity so ordered quantities match the wish list. amazon.clear_cart is included before moving so that only wish-list items end up in the placed order (cart entries are ignored by the evaluation, so clearing is safe). Address is chosen by name 'Work' from amazon.show_addresses (no address is added/updated); any existing payment card is used. Ordering is enforced structurally: moves require (cart-cleared) and (not (order-placed)), so all wish-list items must be moved before amazon.place_order for the per-product goal literals to hold; the complete-task precondition carries the nullary goal (order-placed) because per-product goal literals refer to problem objects and cannot appear in a domain action without quantification. supervisor.complete_task is called with no answer.
